verses.text: The word that the Lord commanded to be proclaimed concerning the king of Babylon, Merodach, and concerning the people who were taken captive to Babylon, this is the book that Jeremiah sent.
Because of your sins against the Lord, the king of Babylon will take you away with a great captivity.
Likewise, you shall be taken to Babylon and shall dwell there for seventy years; for a long time you shall remain there. But after this, I will bring you out from that place in peace.
Now, behold, you shall see the idols of silver and gold, and of wood in Babylon; they shall carry them away with their burdens; and they shall be a burden to the nations.
Therefore, take heed that you do not become like others; and do not let fear come upon you because of them.
When you see the nations being subdued before you, say in your heart, "Alas, captivity is fitting for you."
For my angel shall dwell with you, and he shall take care of your being.
The idols that they have made are but a mere shadow; they are of gold and silver; they are falsehoods, and they cannot speak.
As a bride adorns herself with gold and puts a crown upon her head, so they have adorned their idols.
And among them, the priests were taking gold and silver, and there was a time to seek their favor.
And it was that for those who dwelt in their houses, they were to be given offerings of silver, gold, and wood, as a man would adorn himself in garments.
Their garments were not to be torn from themselves.
They were to be adorned in white linen; and upon them, exceedingly much, was the house's glory that had arisen.
As a man who is fearful, he would take hold of them; yet those who would harm them would not be harmed.
In his hand was a sword and a spear; he would not be turned away from battle and from the foes.
The angels, that they may not be harmed, are known in this; therefore, do not fear them.
The broken vessel of the potter is as those who do not profit; their idols are likewise. In the house, they are to be cast away; and the foot of man that has arisen shall fill their sight.
As a king is adorned upon a man of beauty, so shall they be guarded by their priests in the sanctuary and in the holy place, as a corpse is adorned in the grave.
The lights have shone upon them; yet they see not.
Within the house, they are as a shadow; their belly's vessels are as the beasts of the earth that devour them; and when they are devoured, they know not themselves nor their garments.
በቤተ ጣዖቱ ከሚጤሰው ጢስ የተነሣ ፊታቸው ይጠቍራል።
በአካላቸውና በራሳቸውም ላይ የሌሊት ወፍ፥ ወፎችና ድመት ይቀመጣሉ።
በዚህም እነርሱ አማልክት እንዳይደሉ ታውቃላችሁ፤ እንግዲህ ወዲህ አትፍሩአቸው።
ወርቅ ቢያስቀምጡት ካልወለወሉት እንደማያበራ አያበሩም፤ ቀጥቅጠው ሲሠሯቸውም አያውቁም።
በከፍተኛ ዋጋ ገዟቸው፤ ነገር ግን እስትንፋስ የላቸውም።
እግር የላቸውም፤ ድካማቸውም ይታወቅ ዘንድ በትከሻቸው ይሸከሟቸዋል፤
የሚያመልኳቸው ያፍራሉ፤ በምድርም ላይ ቢወድቁ ራሳቸው አይነሡም፤ ቢያነሡአቸውም ራሳቸው አይቆሙም፤ ቢያዘነብሉም ራሳቸው በራሳቸው ቀጥ አይሉም፤ ለእነርሱም መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ ለሞተ ሰው ምግብ እንደ ማቅረብ ነው።
ካህናቶቻቸውም መሥዋዕታቸውን እየሸጡ ያቃልሏቸዋል። እንደዚሁም ሚስቶቻቸው መሥዋዕቱን ያጣፍጣሉ፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ለበሽተኛና ለድሃ አይሰጡም።
አራሶችና የተዳደፉ ሴቶችም ከመሥዋዕቱ ይነካሉ፤ በዚህም አማልክት እንዳይደሉ ዕወቁ፤ እንግዲህ አትፍሩአቸው።
ሴቶች ከብር ከወርቅና ከእንጨት ለተሠሩ አማልክት መሥዋዕት ካቀረቡላቸው በምን አማልክት ይባላሉ?
And their priests shall minister in the house of their idols; their garments are consecrated; their bodies and their souls are defiled; their very being is unclean.
As they cry out before their idols, they shall be as those who are remembered for death.
And their priests shall strip off their garments and shall give them to their wives and to their children.
Whether a man has done evil to them, or whether he has done good to them, they shall not repay his debt; they shall not acknowledge him; they shall not regard him.
Likewise, they shall not be merciful; they shall not show compassion; if one does not give a gift, they shall not seek after him.
They shall not deliver a man from death; nor shall they deliver the weak from the mighty.
They shall not rescue the blind; nor shall they deliver a man from trouble.
They shall not show kindness to the needy; nor shall they do good to the poor.
Their idols are like stones hewn from the mountain; they are made from wood, gold, and silver that have been cut away. And those who worship them shall be afraid.
In what manner shall they be likened? When the idolaters themselves are broken, how then shall they be called gods?
These words, when the deaf cannot speak, he will speak as he is able to hear, and they will bring him to the house.
Those who know that they cannot hear will not be able to escape from them.
And the women, in their humility, will adorn themselves and will sit by the way; they will also offer the offerings of the harvest.

And if one of them, when she is in the way, is to be taken by the one responsible, and if she lies down as she is ready, she will not be found as her own; and her humility will not be opened, and this one will be cast away from another. All that is done to them is falsehood; how can an angel strike them, when an angel cannot call upon them?
The call-makers and the deceivers have deceived them; and these call-makers are not outside of what they have permitted.
The deceivers they have made will not remain for many generations. How then will these who have been made by them endure forever?
Let go of vanity and deceit for those who come after.
In the time of their warfare and destruction, their priests will flee with them, and they will be entangled with one another.
How can they be angels who do not protect themselves from warfare and destruction?
They are trees adorned with gold and silver; their vanity will be known in the end.
እነርሱም የሰው እጅ ሥራ እንጂ አማልክት እንዳልሆኑ፥ የአምላክነት ሥራም እንደሌላቸው ለአሕዛብና ለነገሥታት ሁሉ በግልጥ ይታወቃሉ።
አማልክት እንዳይደሉ የማያውቅ ማን ነው?
በሀገር ላይ ንጉሥን አያስነሡም፤ ለሰውም ዝናምን አይሰጡም።
ለራሳቸው ፍርድን አይፈርዱም፤ ግፍንም አያርቁም፤ ምንም ማድረግ አይችሉምና፥ በሰማይና በምድር መካከል እንደሚበርሩ ቍራዎች ናቸው።
ከእንጨት፥ ወይም ከወርቅ፥ ወይም ከብር የተሠሩ ጣዖታት ቤት ቢቃጠል፥ ካህናቶቻቸው ሸሽተው ራሳቸውን ያድናሉ፤ እነርሱ ግን እንደ ምሰሶ በመካከል ይቃጠላሉ።
ንጉሥንም ቢሆን፥ ጠላትንም ቢሆን አይቃወሙም፤ እንግዲህ እንዴት አማልክት ናቸው?
ከእንጨት፥ ከብርና ከወርቅ የተሠሩት ጣዖታት ከሌቦችና ከቀማኞች ራሳቸውን አያድኑም።
የሚበረታቱባቸውም ወርቃቸውንና ብራቸውን፥ የተሸፈኑበትንም ልብሶች ይገፉአቸዋል፤ ይዘውም ይሄዳሉ፤ እነርሱ ግን ራሳቸውን እንኳ አይረዱም።
ስለዚህ ከሐሰት አማልክት ይልቅ በኀይሉ የሚመካ ንጉሥ፥ ወይም በቤት ውስጥ የሚጠቅም፥ የገዛውም የሚገለገልበት ሸክላ ይሻላል፤ ወይም በቤት ውስጥ ያለውን ሁሉ የሚያድን መዝጊያ ከሐሰት አማልክት ይልቅ ይሻላል፤ በነገሥታት አዳራሽ ውስጥ ያሉ የእንጨት ምሰሶዎችም ከሐሰት አማልክት ይልቅ ይሻላሉ።
ፀሐይና ጨረቃ፥ ከዋክብትም ብርሃን ናቸውና፥ ለጥቅምም ይላካሉና ይታዘዛሉ።
Likewise, a flame shall be seen from afar when it blazes; even so, the wind shall blow throughout all the land.
And the blood shall be revealed in all the earth, for it has been commanded by the Lord, and they shall fulfill His decrees.
The fire that is sent down from above shall consume the mountains and the trees; yet, these shall not be likened to them in their beauty or in their strength.
Therefore, they shall not be called angels; nor shall angels be named; for they are unable to render judgment for man or to do good.
As angels do not deceive, thus have I made known to you; do not be afraid of them.
They shall not be regarded as kings; they shall not be esteemed.
In heaven, they shall not show a sign to the nations; neither shall they shine like the sun and the moon.
Rather, they shall be like beasts that flee to the refuge and save themselves.
Angels, as they are, have not been revealed in any way; therefore, do not be afraid of them.
In the garden of the wilderness, there are no instruments of fear; their idols, made of wood and adorned with gold and silver, are like this.
Likewise, those who dwell in the heights shall be likened to white lilies that grow in a garden; their idols, fashioned of wood and adorned with silver and gold, are indeed as if cast into darkness.

Know ye that they shall not be adorned with the garments of crimson and the raiment of fine linen, lest they be likened unto the fallen angels; and in the end, they shall perish themselves; they shall become a snare unto the nation.
Therefore, he who is without an idol is better than a man who is distant from the truth.
